parsed.internal_thinking: I have placed my second settlement on node 25, which gives me strong Ore (5) and Wheat (9, 6). Now I need to place my road. Node 26 is an Ore port (O2) and node 37 is a 3:1 port. Building toward node 26 is highly strategic because my settlement at 25 will produce significant Ore (5). Even though I can't build on 26 itself due to the distance rule, building toward it allows me to reach node 16 (also an Ore port) or node 27. However, looking at the board, building toward node 36 leads to node 37 (3:1 port) and node 35 (Brick 10, Sheep 11, Wheat 9), which helps balance my lack of Brick. Given my heavy Ore production, the Ore port is the most logical long-term play to convert that surplus.
parsed.note_to_self: Road placed toward node 26 to secure the Ore port. This will be essential for trading my high Ore yield from node 25.
parsed.say_outloud: A little port access should help balance things out later. It's good to have options when the dice don't go your way.
